messages.subject: Conversations translation
parts:
Hi Filipe,
Going through conversation it feels like many are useful. However, many of them are in spanish. I know that I can copy and use google translation for translating. However, is there a way to put english translation also in the same conversation thread?

messages.author: 9bd637eeb721ebec
messages.subject: Re: Conversations translation
parts:
If you are using Chrome as your browser you can install Translate as an extension and use it to translate entire pages without having to copy/paste back and forth. 
https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/google-translate/aapbdbdomjkkjkaonfhkkikfgjllcleb?hl=en
Other browsers might have a similar function as well.
